messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty page fired (P12345) — service=inference-embeddings-eu severity=high — 5xx + latency spike. Link: https://pd.internal/P12345

mike: ack — oncall here, looking now

pagerduty: mike acknowledged the alert (automated)

danielle: any idea on customer impact? numbers?

mike: roughly 40% of embedding requests hitting 5xx, p95 ~8.4s. seeing kv-cache eviction churn on eu nodes, logs show `kvcache_eviction_rate=0.92`

leo: I can jump in in ~5m to take handoff if needed

mike: following runbook: step1 rollback embedder image to `v2.14`. running: ```kubectl set image deploy/eu-embedder embedder=repo/embed:v2.14 -n prod```

incident-bot: Runbook: Embeddings KV eviction — https://runbooks.internal/embeddings-kv-eviction

customer-ops: alerted top-10 affected accounts and posted incident note to status page (degraded performance). will send targeted emails for customers with reserved capacity

danielle: recommend short-term traffic reroute for critical customers to us-east warm standby while we stabilize eu

mike: rollback hit `ErrImagePull` on 2 pods, looks like the image was not present in eu registry mirror. trying node restart on those nodes

pagerduty: escalation triggered — paging secondary oncall leo (auto after 5m)

leo: taking over. I'll coordinate with infra to scale standby pool and apply route override for critical customers

mike: handing off to leo — tracking in INC-7891, will add logs and current commands

leo: executing traffic-router override: `traffic-router override --region=eu --fallback=us-east --selector=critical-customers` — applied. also increasing eu-standby pool by +3 pods

customer-ops: external status updated: "Mitigation in progress — select customers routed to standby. Next update in 15m."

leo: p95 for critical traffic down to ~1.2s, 5xx rate back within baseline for routed customers. continuing to monitor; will keep thread updated

mike: thanks — I'll own the postmortem and follow up on why mirror missed `v2.14` image publish

incident-bot: PagerDuty page resolved (P12345) — closed by leo. Incident ticket: https://issues.internal/INC-7891

leo: closing notes: mitigation successful, working with build team to fix registry mirror + adding runbook step to validate image mirror before promote

mike: ack, will add timeline and customer impact to the postmortem
thread_summary: Automated PD page for embeddings-eu: oncall ack, rollback attempt failed due to registry mirror, escalation to secondary oncall, traffic reroute to standby, mitigation successful, PD closed
